import os
import sys
import time
import curses

def monitor_log(logfile, keywords):
    try:
        stdscr = curses.initscr()
        curses.start_color()
        curses.use_default_colors()
        curses.init_pair(1, curses.COLOR_RED, -1)
        curses.curs_set(0)

        stdscr.nodelay(True)
        stdscr.clear()

        with open(logfile, 'r') as f:
            f.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
            while True:
                line = f.readline()
                if not line:
                    time.sleep(0.1)
                    continue

                if any(keyword.lower() in line.lower() for keyword in keywords):
                    stdscr.addstr(line, curses.color_pair(1))
                else:
                    stdscr.addstr(line)

                stdscr.refresh()

                char = stdscr.getch()
                if char == ord('q'):
                    break

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        curses.endwin()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) < 3:
        print(f"Usage: {sys.argv[0]} <logfile> <keyword1> [<keyword2>...]")
        sys.exit(1)

    logfile = sys.argv[1]
    keywords = sys.argv[2:]

    monitor_log(logfile, keywords)
